technology_stack.decision: preferred; no repository compatibility issue found
technology_stack.reason: minimal read-only competition demonstrator; no need for a second application stack

principles.read_only: Only open hash-whitelisted frozen artifacts; no write path to outputs/phase7, outputs/phase8, outputs/phase9, outputs/phase9_1 or outputs/phase12.
principles.deterministic: Sort buildings/dates explicitly and apply only contract-declared transformations/rounding.
principles.fail_closed: Before rendering any tab, validate required file existence, SHA-256 and schema. Any mismatch raises FrozenSourceError and stops the app.
principles.no_duplicate_truth: KPI values are resolved by key_id from outputs/phase12/key_number_ledger.csv; no manually copied constants in UI code.
principles.no_fallback: Missing/invalid sources never fall back to old reports, images or earlier outputs.
principles.simulation_label: Every storage view shows Simulation-based evaluation / 仿真验证.
principles.lineage_boundary: This is a presentation/data-consumption path using contract-whitelisted outputs, not a repair of src.final_algorithm.
